authority: main_implementation plan.md P08.1; api design.md section 3.9; P05 atomic budget reservations
decision: Require org:read scope and server-resolved organization membership. Accept only 24h, 7d or 30d windows and organization grouping. Aggregate tenant-RLS run budget reservations created within the selected window.
meaning: Amounts are eight-decimal USD budget ceilings, grouped by current reservation state. A released ceiling is capacity returned to the plan, not money spent or saved. Actual billing, model tokens and source bytes are null because durable accounting for them does not exist.
local_verification: 17 affected HTTP/contract tests and three disposable PostgreSQL tests passed, including real budget reservation and release plus P05 queue regressions.
remaining: True usage metering, organization quotas by source/model/task, throughput rate limits and staging acceptance remain open. The mandatory P08 test_budget_accounting_and_rate_limit assertion cannot pass until rate limits exist.
